derivedBy: independent model pass (c): fresh-context read of git:parity-baseline:server.js and public/script.js (initWebSocket) only. No fixture and no other derivation was consulted.

transport.library: socket.io v4 server, socket.io.esm.min.js client served from public/
transport.endpoint: same origin as the page (io() with no URL), i.e. http://localhost:7837
transport.serverSetup: io is attached to the same httpServer that serves the API, created before the routes and started by httpServer.listen(PORT)

payload.data: string - one raw child pipe chunk, data.toString() of the whole chunk

serverToClient.emitTarget: every entry of the module-level connectedClients array, via client.emit inside connectedClients.forEach
contract: no line splitting and no server-side trim: a chunk that ends mid-line is delivered as one event mid-line, and a whitespace-only chunk is delivered as a whitespace-only event
the same bytes are also console.log'd by the manager as 'STDOUT: <chunk>' / 'STDERR: <chunk>'

emittedFrom: the 'close' handler of every spawned child (all three spawn sites)
contract: fired once per child close, including a child that exits by itself; the manager also console.logs 'Server process exited with code <code>' first

emittedFrom: the 'error' handler of every spawned child (all three spawn sites)
contract: spawn errors surface as an error event, not as a throw; the handler also nulls runningProcess

absentEvents.fact: no emit of that name exists anywhere in server.js; the client learns about a successful start from the POST response, not from a socket event
metrics and status are polled over HTTP only; nothing is pushed

clientToServer.note: the client never emits a custom event; it only connects and disconnects

server: io.on('connection'): console.log('Client connected for log streaming') then connectedClients.push(socket)
socket.on('disconnect'): console.log('Client disconnected from log streaming'), then indexOf + splice(index,1) when index > -1
connectedClients is module level and grows per socket; stale entries are removed only by the disconnect handler
client: initWebSocket() is called only after a successful POST /start, POST /restart or POST /launch-presets response
initWebSocket() returns immediately when the module-level socket is already non-null
on a successful POST /stop the client calls socket.disconnect() and sets socket = null, so the next start reconnects
io() is called with no arguments, so the socket URL is the page origin - settings.serverPort never affects it

clientHandlers.behavior: showOutput('Connected to server for real-time logging') plus a console.log
if (data && data.data) showOutput(data.data.trim()) - the trim is per event, so a chunk boundary inside a word produces two pane lines
showOutput('Server process has ended'); updateStatus(false); updateButtonStates(false)
showOutput('Disconnected from server for real-time logging')

paneRules.cap: keep the last 1000 entries of textContent.split('\n')
paneRules.initialText: the markup ships with 'No output yet...' inside #modelOutput, so the first real entry is appended after that line
